sources.title: Network denial of service
sources.text: Connection bursts and error rates may indicate network denial of service. Check baselines, server capacity and maintenance windows; corroborate with packet or flow evidence before containment.

sources.title: Network service discovery
sources.text: High connection count across services can justify reviewing flow destinations and firewall logs. Validate approved vulnerability scanners before escalation. Network scanning is a hypothesis, not proof.

sources.title: Brute force investigation
sources.text: Repeated authentication failures warrant identity-log correlation, checking account owner and source addresses, and validating expected automation. Preserve logs. Request analyst approval before any account restriction.

summary: This network record is a triage lead, not a confirmed compromise. Calibrated score applies only to this benchmark distribution. Authentication and endpoint corroboration are not present in KDD99.
recommended_steps: Validate source data and asset context
Check approved scans, maintenance and known automation
Correlate independent identity/endpoint logs before deciding containment
response: No response executed. Human review required.
